# Common Algorithms

Here are some common algorithms that you should know. You can find more information about them in the Algorithms section of the Computer Science course.

*   Sorting
*   Recursion
*   Searching
*   Cache Algorithms
*   Tree Algorithms
*   Graph Algorithms
*   Greedy Algorithms
*   Backtracking
*   Substring Search
*   Suffix Arrays
*   Dynamic Programming
